## Fixed P1 channel and release-byte eligibility — 2026-10-21

**Metadata-only, conditionally eligible; no capture or new behavioral IDs selected.** Two independent typed axes share one baseline history: matching zero-based MIDI channel nibbles0–15 change both note statuses together (90+n / 80+n), while note-off velocity bytes0–127 change off data2 only with statuses90/80. They are not a crossproduct. All144 aliases deduplicate to143 distinct complete histories: two baseline aliases refer to one approved P1 history, leaving142 currently missing histories (15 channels1–15 plus127 off velocities1–127). These input units are not required predicates, family coverage, candidate passes or evidence of public admission.

The common input is all33 ordered P1 binary32 words, vector SHA-256`9ef2b39d47ca833730a9bbfd9d26e3bdc08a847df0ead035bd14d948bc35a43a`; key60/note-on velocity100; on frame11264/off33314; warm11264 then render44100 at44100Hz in512blocks/last68; zero audio/flag0; stopped0,0,120; existing time0/defaultFP/provider/model treatment. For each row below only the named status nibble pair or off data2 varies. Event records are the existing16-byte little-endian `<qBBBB4x` packed frame/status/key/velocity/reserved representation; allother event fields remain fixed. Fresh waveform priors, portable expected/comparator and grades are NULL throughout the catalog. No numeric waveform expectation, metric, fit, f0, tolerance, calibration, new parameter or state axis is supplied.

The inherited baseline is [approved velocity100](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/electric-velocity-bytes-v1-review.json#/approved_summary/approved_points/100), retaining ETI-12 / DEL-CS-001 / P1 / ELECTRIC-AUDIO-004 aliases and no fresh PID/receipt/metric. That sole review is1,016,304bytes/SHA-256`7b89ba1553c6a5ebdf92b2931d09aae1095454aadc8a391c5bdde1b7dab55b66`; its complete shared input, words, fixture, admitted model/runtime and inert method-source identities are inherited, not actual/source/raw observations re-reviewed. Full note-key and Transpose controls likewise collapse only to this same baseline, not additional changed-channel or release-byte points. No unreviewed Electric31 actual/code/raw/result payload is opened for this assessment.

The exact120 old script paths already pinned in [Root’s finite-host assessment](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/electric-fixed-p1-finite-host-domain-eligibility.json) (30,157bytes/`f7fb4a47d8728f5d24249973545c8e7a8ea514f933ab4620d281e711cb2e8d78`) were checked afresh as INPUT declarations only. No other exact member appears within this selected120-script cut; no universal absence follows.

Only AST call arguments for `el.note`/`el.render` at lines63–69 were extracted; surrounding comparisons, numeric results, estimators and DSP behavior were excluded and nothing imported/executed. The calls are:

- Line63, columns9–35: `el.note(60, 100, 0, 13230)`; source-segment SHA-256`5cac94e387d73ba2ab8fe0250efbadeefa57a9312ca9a9ba0913ec6cd608aa6b`.

- Line69, columns45–125: `el.render(H, [(0, 0x9f, 60, 100), (13230, 0x8f, 60, 0)], 44100, 'm_ch16', 22050)`; source-segment SHA-256`442521c42b12cc173bc2a95fc53e94bfbfc01339264cf4cf3335327fde4b7901`.

The existing approved recipe metadata supplies warmup11264 at44100Hz. These old calls render22050frames and place the second event at render13230, hence absolute off24494/end33314, versus P1 off33314/end55364. This difference alone prevents a P1 join, even before any retained H-vector/source-version uncertainty. `m_rv` covers old release127; `m_ch` and `m_ch16` use matching nibbles1/15. `m_v0` sends another status90/velocity0 after the original note-on; it is neither the selected status80 off-byte axis nor this complete P1 history. Their old Boolean statements retain their own qualified scopes and supply no new PID, audio, parameter-receiver, timing or exact P1 observation here. Current retained source bytes do not independently attest the original executed source version. No old audio, numeric result or estimator was read/recomputed.

The unchanged existing Electric-specific xdev route (149,688bytes/SHA-256`6eb5dd284452960f623e0bb6ed26b8743bdf789b8eac09a48b4a9291995ed8e1`) already accepts the supplied fixed event records through the approved factory/rate/33-setter/warm/render/destroy protocol. This identifies a concrete standing-input prospect without new object, receiver, patch, tool, build, provider, seed or FP treatment. It does not establish what Live emits, a current parameter/receiver, cross-channel voice behavior or velocity independence. A future selected142-child sweep would contain20,590 selected direct exports/15,478CalcA/62,893,504stereo bytes including warmup, with initializer/nested counts separate. No original call is selected by this assessment. First-fault/NULL-prior policy and fresh code/input/custody binding would belong to that later selected batch, not a new preparation gate here.
